resources.rule_zh: 只使用已授权、可撤场的试点界面
resources.rule_en: Use only authorized, reversible pilot interfaces

resources.rule_zh: 共享首层、公共前场、受控测试区按时段开放
resources.rule_en: Time-share ground floors, public forecourts, and controlled test zones

resources.rule_zh: 企业提交问题与测试件，不取得自动上线权
resources.rule_en: Teams submit problems and test articles without automatic release rights

resources.rule_zh: 先按 S/M/L 资源等级决策，金额待授权主体测算
resources.rule_en: Use S/M/L resource classes first; authorized parties price later

resources.rule_zh: 学生、专业人员、运营者和当事人共同复核
resources.rule_en: Students, specialists, operators, and affected users review together

resources.rule_zh: 优先离线、低功耗和可降级服务
最少字段、到期删除、公开来源与匿名汇总
resources.rule_en: Minimum fields, expiry deletion, public sources, and anonymous aggregates

resources.rule_zh: 真实任务先于设备展示，每项测试服务至少一项公共任务
resources.rule_en: Real tasks precede device display; each test serves at least one public task

decision_rule: No resource is treated as secured until an accountable party records authorization, quantity, term, and exit condition.
